matches.name: job batch
matches.description: Run multiple registered commands in one transactional request. Later ops can reference earlier results with "$<id-or-index>.<jsonPath>" (e.g. "$0.instanceId"; "$$" escapes a literal '$'). transactional=true (default) groups every op into one Undo step and reverts all applied ops if any op fails; commands that mutate outside the Undo system (asset/file/settings writes) are rejected unless transactional=false. on_error=abort|continue (continue forces transactional=false); dry_run validates without mutating; timeout (seconds, default 60) bounds execution — when it is about to run out the remaining ops are skipped and a transactional batch rolls back (submit long batches with "job": true). Excludes build run, build.target switch, the package commands, editor.playmode start/stop/pause, script recompile, script eval, script eval_file, script run, editor invoke_menu, scene open/scene create, async commands (test run/test list), runtime-only commands, and nested job batch.

matches.name: navmesh bake
matches.description: Trigger an async legacy NavMesh bake of the open scene(s) via UnityEditor.AI.NavMeshBuilder. Returns immediately; poll navmesh bake_status until completed.

matches.name: package add
matches.description: Add a UPM package by name@version, git URL, or 'file:' local path. Async by default (returns in_progress; poll package status); pass wait=true to block until added. A recompile/domain reload follows — poll script recompile_status. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview.

matches.name: package remove
matches.description: Remove a UPM package by name. Async by default (returns in_progress; poll package status); pass wait=true to block until removed. A recompile/domain reload follows — poll script recompile_status. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview.

matches.name: package resolve
matches.description: Resolve/refresh packages from the manifest (re-fetch and re-link). May trigger a recompile/domain reload — poll script recompile_status. Its outcome is recorded for package status.

matches.name: script attach
matches.description: Add a MonoBehaviour to a GameObject by its (compiled) type name OR by its script asset path. Provide exactly one of 'type' or 'script'. If the type isn't compiled yet, returns a recoverable error: script recompile, poll script recompile_status, then retry.

matches.name: script create
matches.description: Create a new C# script (default base class MonoBehaviour) from a template under the authoring root. NOTE: the type does not exist until a recompile completes — to attach it, call script recompile, poll script recompile_status, then script attach.

matches.name: script eval

matches.name: script run
